text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to build ability has ended.
Daiichi Ruby, who had struggled until the very end,
now wears an unclouded look of resolve. And then—
(Vrooooom...)

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
Milady, Trainer, thank you for waiting.
Please step into the car.

From here, the two of us were heading straight to her family home—
to meet with her legendary mother.
I must go report how we shall proceed from here on out... to the current symbol of the "Illustrious Family."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Let us hold our heads high.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If you have confidence
in *our* decision—

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Ruby.
How were things over there?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: It wasn't too hot, and the training went smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear that.
Now then...

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: I heard you wished to speak with me. Please, go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Be brilliant. Be supreme.
Always shine the brightest...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
In other words, deliver a magnificent run upon the supreme stage,
and claim the brightest radiance—victory.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I have striven forward
in accordance with this golden rule.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: To leave behind brilliant achievements on the Triple Tiara route just like Mother—she believed that to be her mission.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: "...Yet, you do not think so now?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "That brilliance... was not in the path, but in this very blood."

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Blood... the blood of the "Illustrious Clan," isn't it?
How have you interpreted its essence?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —It's speed.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To get straight to the point.
I am...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I want to discover my greatest brilliance on the sprint route.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...There must have been a major reason
for making such a decision. What was it?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Trainer has bestowed a revelation upon me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...I was seeking proof of being
part of the 'Illustrious Lineage' in my path."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Having lost my way from the moment of my birth...
I could not validate my own existence
without following in everyone's footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
However, I... already possessed
that proof within me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: The speed carried down through generations of Umamusume in our family... that blood undeniably flows within me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: With these legs, I can reach the light—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Toward a light even more dazzling than continuing along the Triple Tiara route...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Indeed, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, this is the decision I have arrived at.
Mother—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if I stepped off the royal road
and moved into sprinting instead?

Inside the spacious room, the silence lingered.
Then, Daiichi Ruby's mother opened her mouth and――

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...You truly are my pride.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since I saw you start running,
I've been convinced of it."

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: "You are the culmination of our 'Illustrious Lineage,' possessing speed second to none—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: The crystallization is... Mother.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Mother possesses a brilliant track record—

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—In the Twinkle Series,
what is it that the "Illustrious Clan" should seek?

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
My family has stood at the very pinnacle in every field.
And on the racetrack, as well...

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Then what does it mean to be at the top in racing?
—It is 'speed.'"

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: The one who is the fastest—is the most magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: The one who is the fastest...

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I too pursued speed.
Setting records, making a name for myself as
a blisteringly fast horse girl, and then—

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—I hit the limits of my speed and was defeated.
I retired, but...

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: If it's you—you can see what lies beyond that.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I believe you are already aware, Trainer.
Of the current state surrounding the racing world...

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the world will lean even more toward raw speed.
That is precisely why your late-stage kick will shine brighter than ever.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Mother...

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Those around you will likely expect the orthodox path.
However, please trust in your own decision.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Demonstrate that pride on the sprint path,
and become the new symbol of our family.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: You will... surpass me.

Hearing her mother's passionate words,
Daiichi Ruby fell silent,
staring blankly into space for a while.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...The Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
This is a race won by both my grandmother and my mother.
I shall make it my first goal for the Senior Class.

The Takamatsunomiya Kinen is a Senior-tier GⅠ race.
It is the race that crowns the spring sprint champion.
To take on that challenge means—
choice_data_list: So you're really switching to sprint races starting in the Senior Class.
So you're really switching to sprint races starting in the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Along that path, as one of the "Illustrious Clan"...
I shall show you that I can reach the light.

A small flame seemed to ignite within Daiichi Ruby.
Her joy truly comes from the bottom of her heart,
dedicated to her family—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Can I shine...
down this path?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
First, the upcoming Rose Stakes...
I shall show you splendid results there.

As she speaks, Daiichi Ruby looks
somewhat liberated.
